mood: A record you cut: a printed sleeve, liner notes, two inks and a diagonal slice.
concept: The interface is the sleeve, label and liner notes of the pressing on the key art. Everything is a print in two spot inks on dark stock with paper-white type; depth is overprint and a hard offset, never light.

roles.cyan: side A, the top lane, selected, the player
roles.pink: side B, the bottom lane, the record, danger
roles.paper: all type, the primary button, hover
roles.label: wells, fields, the sleeve box

fonts.accent: Bodoni Moda Italic (one word at a time)
fonts.mono: IBM Plex Mono (every number, label and catalogue line)

shape.borderStyle: 1px paper hairline at 28%; the primary button's right edge is the cut
shape.texture: line screen, halftone dots, grain; misregistration by hard offset

motifs: the slice (a diagonal cut, eight degrees, a hairline gap)
the sleeve's printed track box (A1 Library, A2 Daily, B1 Setlists, B2 Versus)
buttonStyle: Primary is a paper slab with the cut as its right edge, inverting to cyan on hover; secondary is outlined in paper and inverts on hover. No radius, no glow.
backdrop: Flat ink with grain. No runway, no equalizer bars, no gradient wash.
motion: Mechanical: stepped and short. Hover is an instant invert, a selection cuts in 180 ms, screens change with a wipe along the slice line. A hit slices the note in two and the halves slide apart; nothing flashes. Ambient motion is a single slow groove drift that stops when the tab is hidden.
notThis: Neon outlines, glow, glass, equalizer bars, perspective runways, rounded pill cards, gradient buttons, sparkles.
